content: {"paper_id":"W4225338017","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"Multi-View Subspace Clustering","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确将多视图子空间聚类作为研究任务；摘要也表明方法用于多视图子空间聚类。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-view subspace clustering methods used consensus and supplementary principles to learn the shared self-representation matrix or tensor have been applied to multiple fields.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要表明研究多视图数据，并通过共识与补充原则学习共享自表示，显式联合利用多个视图之间的关系。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"by introducing a nonconvex Laplace function to replace the tensor nuclear norm, HNLR can greatly improve the approximate performance of the global low-rank structure.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以非凸Laplace函数替代张量核范数，改进全局低秩结构近似，属于显式低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"HNLR uses hyper-Laplacian regularizer to capture the high-order local geometry structure of each view.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用超拉普拉斯正则器捕获各视图高阶局部几何结构，符合用图/超图结构施加几何一致性约束的定义。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"超拉普拉斯正则及自表示矩阵提示可能涉及样本间结构，但摘要未说明是否学习或修正边/邻接/亲和矩阵，无法按定义确认。"}],"input_issues":[]}
